title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1987-09-11
source: Master: Nakamichi CM100's/CP4's>Marantz PMD-420>Cass(m), Nak DR-2>Tascam CDRW2000>CD by Jon Pasternak; Extraction: CD>xACT 2.13 (cdparanoia)>WAV>FLAC, all tracks extracted with no errors by Dave Mallick

ai_review.summary: Audio plagued by microphone/cable problems and riser bleed, with no clear musical highlights noted
ai_review.review: The recording suffers from significant technical flaws – frequent mic or cable drop‑outs in the first set and pervasive footstep noise from taper rigs on the risers. Reviewers provide no commentary on the performance itself, making the show quality indeterminate.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews focus mainly on poor recording issues (2‑3 stars) and give no positive musical feedback; with limited data the rating reflects a subpar listening experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Frequent microphone/cable problems, undocumented cuts (e.g., missing start of Desolation), and heavy footstep/riser bleed throughout the tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments on set structure or pacing were provided.
